comment: lab4chain CHAINED POWER DEPENDENCY TRAINING scenarios (10 of 16) held-in set for QL training. Held-OUT (test-only): 3 (the signature DEEP trap: lamp+plug ON, breaker OFF — subtlest chain break), 4, 8, 12, 14, 15 (spotlight-redundancy and energy-optimization cases). The chain starts fully open wherever the Z1 lamp is needed, so the agent learns the depth-2 dependency (z1lamp_on = Z1Light AND PlugZ1 AND MasterSwitch). Scenario 7 is the held-in MID trap (plug is the missing link); scenario 11 is the held-in DOUBLE-DEEP trap (plug AND breaker missing). Full sun coverage (ranks 0..3). Targets Z1=bright(3), Z2=bright(3).
description: sun=0, all off, chain fully open -> enable breaker + plug + both lamps
sun=0, both at target (full chain live) -> hold
sun=1, all off, chain fully open -> enable breaker + plug + both lamps
sun=1, both at target (full chain live) -> hold
sun=1, Z1 switch ON, breaker ON, plug OFF -> flip the PLUG (held-in MID trap)
sun=2, all off, chain fully open -> enable breaker + plug + both lamps
sun=2, both at target (full chain live) -> hold
sun=2, Z1 switch ON, plug AND breaker OFF -> flip breaker AND plug (held-in DOUBLE-DEEP trap)
sun=3, all off -> open both blinds (835 each, zero energy)
sun=3, both at target via blinds only -> hold
